title: Comint long-lived shell cwd and tool drift

environment.system_features: ACL GMP GNUTLS LIBSELINUX LIBXML2 MODULES NATIVE_COMP NOTIFY INOTIFY PDUMPER SECCOMP SQLITE3 THREADS TREE_SITTER ZLIB

mechanism: Comint owns a live process buffer whose cwd, input boundary, and environment can drift across submitted commands.
hypothesis: A persistent shell launched through Comint should retain cwd changes, preserve the Insula run id, and resolve tools through the selected rootfs after state changes.
minimal_fixture: One long-lived `/bin/sh' Comint process, a submitted command that changes cwd, and tool/Python identity probes after the change.
predicted_behavior: Production mode should show a live shell process, cwd persistence into `/project/tmp', stable run id, and rootfs-owned tool resolution.
observed_behavior:
prod=t pid=760 proc-exe="/usr/bin/dash" output="printf 'SOMA_BEFORE:%s\\n' \"$PWD\"; cd \"$TMPDIR\"; printf 'SOMA_AFTER:%s\\n' \"$PWD\"; printf 'SOMA_RUN:%s\\n' \"$SOMA_INSULA_RUN_ID\"; printf 'SOMA_PY:%s\\n' \"$(command -v python3 || true)\"; python3 -c 'import json, os, sys; print(\"SOMA_PY_JSON:\" + json.dumps({\"executable\": sys.executable, \"cwd\": os.getcwd(), \"run_id\": os.environ.get(\"SOMA_INSULA_RUN_ID\", \"\")}, sort_keys=True))'; printf 'SOMA_DONE\\n'
$ SOMA_BEFORE:/workspace/soma
SOMA_AFTER:/project/tmp
SOMA_RUN:20260930T040324Z-4018462
SOMA_PY:/usr/bin/python3
SOMA_PY_JSON:{\"cwd\": \"/project/tmp\", \"executable\": \"/usr/bin/python3\", \"run_id\": \"20260930T040324Z-4018462\"}
SOMA_DONE
$ "

counterexample: A one-shot subprocess check can miss cwd drift, stale process identity, user input below the process mark, or PATH mutation across later sends.
derived_gym_requirement: Comint actions must record process pid/executable, process mark, cwd, live input, tool resolution, and environment after every wait or submitted command.
